item.cuteferrets.ferret_whistle.tooltip1: Right-click: all your ferrets come running
item.cuteferrets.ferret_whistle.tooltip2: Sneak + right-click: all your ferrets lie down and wait
item.cuteferrets.ferret_treat.tooltip: Tames instantly. For your own ferret: lots of love and luck for 2 minutes
mode.cuteferrets.sit.tooltip: The ferret flops into a pancake and waits
mode.cuteferrets.wander.tooltip: The ferret roams freely around this spot
mode.cuteferrets.dig.tooltip: Follows you and digs in dirt, sand and gravel for treasure
mode.cuteferrets.ore.tooltip: Sniffs out ores: mines reachable ones itself and tells you where to dig for buried ones
gui.cuteferrets.affection.tooltip: Affection: pet and feed your ferret. Higher affection means more frequent, luckier digs and a longer ore-sniffing range
